newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli allegedly assaults Arab woman under curfew.
newsitem.headline: Israeli allegedly assaults Arab woman under curfew.

text.p: A Palestinian woman in the West Bank's Surif village, the home of an Islamist suicide bomber that is currently under curfew, accused an Israeli border policeman of sexually assaulting her, police said on Sunday.
A police spokeswoman said the complaint had been passed on by border police commanders in the West Bank to a special investigative unit.
"The border police filed the complaint to the special department for police investigation," she told Reuters.

Israel's High Court on Sunday rejected an appeal by the family of the bomber -- who killed himself and three Israeli women a week ago in Tel Aviv -- against army demolition of their home in the West Bank.
The village has been under curfew since the attack.
Israeli security sources said it was possible the demolition of the home near Hebron could take place in the next 24 hours.
